stylePrompt: Mature learner-facing educational illustration, landscape 3:2, one clear focal meaning, varied painterly or naturalist styles, no photographic or live-action impression, no in-image teaching text, logos or watermarks. Every readable face has natural features and complete hands. Avoid blank faces, chibi proportions, glossy toy rendering, realistic skin pores, stock-photo staging and readable interfaces.

items.sentenceEn: She stops to drink water after the hike.
items.sentenceZh: 她徒步后停下来喝水。
items.scene: One adult hiker safely stops in the shade and lifts a clear reusable bottle to drink water, with her backpack resting beside her.
items.altText: 一名徒步者在树荫下停步，用透明水瓶喝水。

items.sentenceEn: The sun shines above the solar panels.
items.sentenceZh: 太阳照耀着太阳能板。
items.scene: One large bright sun is clearly visible above a field of solar panels, sending warm morning light and distinct rays across the landscape.
items.altText: 一轮明亮太阳高悬在太阳能板上方，阳光洒满田野。

items.sentenceEn: The surveyor measures the distance between two towers.
items.sentenceZh: 测量员测量两座塔之间的距离。
items.scene: Exactly two matching observation towers stand far apart across an open valley while one adult surveyor uses a tripod rangefinder along a clear line between them.
items.altText: 两座相隔很远的塔之间，测量员用三脚仪器测量距离。

items.sentenceEn: The carpenter builds the shelf from wood.
items.sentenceZh: 木匠用木材制作书架。
items.scene: One adult carpenter assembles a simple shelf from clearly grained unfinished wooden boards, with a neat stack of matching lumber beside the workbench.
items.altText: 木匠用纹理清晰的木板制作书架，工作台旁堆着同类木材。

items.sentenceEn: She turns the handle to open the door.
items.sentenceZh: 她转动把手开门。
items.scene: A close view shows one adult hand firmly turning one curved brass door handle downward as the wooden door begins to open.
items.altText: 一只手向下转动黄铜门把手，木门随之开启。

items.sentenceEn: The truck carries crates to the market.
items.sentenceZh: 卡车把货箱运往市场。
items.scene: One medium unbranded delivery truck carries secured produce crates along a rural road toward a visible market shelter, with one adult driver inside.
items.altText: 一辆中型货车载着固定好的农产品箱驶向市场。

items.sentenceEn: A tall mountain rises above the valley.
items.sentenceZh: 一座高山耸立在山谷之上。
items.scene: One dominant tall mountain with a rocky summit rises steeply above a green valley, its complete base-to-peak form clearly visible.
items.altText: 一座高耸的岩顶山峰从绿色山谷中拔地而起。

items.sentenceEn: The engineers survey the land before construction.
items.sentenceZh: 工程师在施工前测量土地。
items.scene: Exactly two adult land surveyors measure an empty building site: one operates a tripod total station and the other holds a vertical survey rod at a marked point.
items.altText: 两名土地测量员用三脚仪器和标杆测量空地。

items.sentenceEn: The large crate was supposed to fit through the doorway.
items.sentenceZh: 这个大箱子本应能通过门口。
items.scene: Exactly two adult movers discover that one large crate expected to pass through a doorway is visibly wider than the opening, contrasting the prior assumption with reality.
items.altText: 两名搬运者发现大木箱比门口还宽，原以为能通过却无法进入。

items.sentenceEn: The family continues its lantern-making tradition.
items.sentenceZh: 这个家庭延续制作灯笼的传统。
items.scene: Exactly three generations of adults gather at one worktable to make the same style of paper lantern by hand, with several earlier finished lanterns carefully preserved nearby.
items.altText: 三代成年人围桌制作同一式样的纸灯笼，延续家族传统。

items.meaningZh: 冬季；萧条期；衰退期；冬天的
items.sentenceEn: Snow covers the town during winter.
items.sentenceZh: 冬天白雪覆盖小镇。
items.scene: A quiet town street in winter has fresh snow, bare deciduous trees, icy breath in the air and one warmly dressed adult clearing a safe walkway.
items.altText: 冬日小镇街道覆着新雪，树木落叶，一名成年人清理步道。

items.sentenceEn: The village gathers around a shared well.
items.sentenceZh: 村庄环绕着一口共用水井。
items.scene: A compact rural village of modest homes, gardens and small workshops clusters around a shared central well, linked by footpaths and surrounded by fields.
items.altText: 一座紧凑乡村由住宅、菜园和作坊组成，房屋围绕公共水井分布。

items.sentenceEn: The Soviet spacecraft is displayed in a history museum.
items.sentenceZh: 这艘苏联航天器陈列在历史博物馆中。
items.scene: In a neutral history museum, one accurate early spherical Soviet space capsule is displayed beside an unlabeled outline map of the former Soviet Union and a 1960s-era orbital diagram.
items.altText: 历史博物馆陈列一艘早期苏联球形太空舱，旁边有前苏联地图轮廓。

items.sentenceEn: She politely refuses another slice of cake.
items.sentenceZh: 她礼貌地拒绝再来一块蛋糕。
items.scene: Exactly two adults sit at a table: one offers a plate with cake, while the other smiles politely and clearly refuses with one open raised palm and a gentle head shake.
items.altText: 一人递出蛋糕，另一人微笑并抬起手掌礼貌拒绝。

items.sentenceEn: Bread sales are strong at the morning market.
items.sentenceZh: 早市上的面包销售很好。
items.scene: At a morning market bakery stall, one adult vendor completes several visible bread purchases while once-full display baskets are nearly empty and a tidy coin tray has filled.
items.altText: 早市面包摊不断成交，原本装满的篮子快空了，钱盘逐渐装满。

items.sentenceEn: The baker uses a pin to roll the dough flat.
items.sentenceZh: 面包师用擀面杖把面团擀平。
items.scene: One adult baker pushes a wooden rolling pin across a round piece of dough, with the flattened area visibly spreading beneath the rolling motion.
items.altText: 面包师推动木质擀面杖，把圆面团逐渐擀平。

items.sentenceEn: Radios maintain communication across the valley.
items.sentenceZh: 无线电保持山谷两侧的通信。
items.scene: Exactly two adult rescue workers stand on opposite sides of a wide valley using handheld radios, connected by a subtle visual radio-wave arc through a relay antenna.
items.altText: 两名救援人员在山谷两侧用无线电保持沟通，中间有中继天线。

items.sentenceEn: The screen keeps insects outside the open window.
items.sentenceZh: 纱窗让昆虫留在打开的窗户外面。
items.scene: A fine mesh screen fills an open window frame, allowing a breeze through while several insects remain visibly outside and one curtain moves gently indoors.
items.altText: 打开的窗户装着细密纱窗，风吹动室内窗帘，昆虫被挡在外面。

items.sentenceEn: The sapling gains height each season.
items.sentenceZh: 这棵树苗每个季节都会长高。
items.scene: A single sapling is shown in three clearly sequential seasonal stages from left to right, each stage taller than the previous one against the same measuring fence.
items.altText: 同一棵树苗按三个季节阶段从左到右逐渐长高。

items.sentenceEn: A resident tends the building's shared garden.
items.sentenceZh: 一名居民照料楼里的共享花园。
items.scene: One adult who clearly lives in the surrounding apartment building steps from its doorway to water a familiar shared courtyard garden, carrying a key ring and small watering can.
items.altText: 一名从公寓楼门口出来的居民拿着钥匙和浇水壶照料共享花园。
